title: cassandra ferruginea
intro: Cassandra ferruginea, commonly known as the Ironwood or Red Ironwood, is a plant species belonging to the family Ebenaceae. It is used in traditional medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever and inflammation, alleviate pain, and treat respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Cassandra ferruginea are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are achieved through its bioactive constituents, including phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and alkaloids. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's ability to modulate immune responses and provide protection against oxidative stress.
